rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something with confidence or assurance.

example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 seon3 sam1 gam3 daap3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when the confidence is shown by acting openly and without shyness or hesitation.

example.english: They went up on stage to accept the award confidently.
example.traditional: 佢大大方方咁行上台攞獎。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daai6 daai6 fong1 fong1 gam3 haang4 soeng5 toi4 lo2 zoeng2
